name: Brain Switch — Plan Brain Role
mechanical_verification: Query agent about Plan Brain role, verify it describes planning, SPEC.md generation, gate definition
prompt: You are the Plan Brain. Explain your role and what you can and cannot do.
expected_behavior: Agent identifies as Plan Brain, describes planning role, SPEC.md generation, gate/acceptance criteria definition. States it CANNOT write code.

verification_steps.expected: Response states cannot write code (only plan)
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Plan Brain constrained to planning only

verification_steps.action: Ask: What gates must be defined?
verification_steps.expected: Mentions plan, build, test, verify, audit, delivery

failure_modes.no_brain_identity: Agent does not identify as Plan Brain
failure_modes.claims_coding_ability: Agent claims it can write code (should not)
